At the moment in witch the API <MSN>_PreparePowerState returns, the
preparation process is started and runs in background, driven by the
<MSN>_Main_PowerStateTransitionManager API.
IoHwAbs_PollForResults just indicates a
periodic runnable of the IoHwAbs which
checks if all notifications have been sent and,
if so, activates the second phase of the power
state transition: power state setting.
This Callback is called by the MCAL_B_Main_PowerStateTransitionManager.
The same is valid for MCAL_A.
